items.text: Radio jockeying, anchoring and voice-over are voice-led careers in which you are hired for your voice, language skill and reliability on air or on a mic, and where a strong demo and steady auditions count for far more than a course certificate.
Record a demo, practise in the language and style a market wants and audition repeatedly.
Check current listings and ask working professionals before you pay.
